title: Transformation — Simple, Complex, Compound & Degree
titleBn: বাক্য রূপান্তর — সরল, জটিল, যৌগিক ও ডিগ্রি
lede: একই অর্থ, ভিন্ন গঠন। Clause গুনতে পারলেই বাক্যের ধরন চেনা যায়, আর ধরন চিনলেই রূপান্তরের নিয়ম হাতের মুঠোয়।

objectives.d: ১টি finite verb = Simple, principal+subordinate = Complex, দুটি principal = Compound
যেখানে অর্থ বা গঠন ভেঙে যায়

rules.name: কীভাবে চিনবে — clause গোনো
rules.bn: **Simple** = একটিমাত্র finite verb (একটি clause)। **Complex** = একটি principal + এক বা একাধিক subordinate clause (that, who, when, if, because…)। **Compound** = দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause (and, but, or, so)।
rules.formula: 1 clause = Simple · principal + subordinate = Complex · principal + principal = Compound
rules.ex: **S:** He is too weak to walk. **C:** He is so weak that he cannot walk. **Cd:** He is very weak and cannot walk.

rules.name: Simple → Complex : participle → clause
rules.bn: Simple-এর **participle/phrase**-কে subordinate clause-এ ভাঙতে হয়। শুরুতে **as, since, when, because** বসিয়ে subject + verb যোগ করো।
rules.formula: V-ing phrase → when / as + sub + verb
rules.ex: **S:** Being ill, he could not come. → **C:** ==As he was ill==, he could not come.

rules.name: Simple → Complex : too … to
rules.bn: **too … to** গঠনকে **so … that + sub + cannot/could not + V1** করতে হয়।
rules.formula: too + adj + to → so + adj + that + sub + cannot + V1
rules.ex: **S:** He is too weak to walk. → **C:** He is ==so weak that he cannot walk==.

rules.name: Simple → Complex : noun/adjective phrase
rules.bn: কোনো noun-এর বিশেষণধর্মী phrase-কে **relative clause** (who/which/that) দিয়ে ভাঙা হয়।
rules.formula: Noun + phrase → Noun + who / which / that + verb
rules.ex: **S:** I know his address. → **C:** I know ==where he lives==.

rules.name: Complex → Simple : clause → phrase
rules.bn: Subordinate clause-কে **participle, infinitive বা preposition-phrase**-এ সংকুচিত করতে হয়।
rules.formula: As + sub + verb → V-ing / Being / In spite of + noun
rules.ex: **C:** As he was tired, he took rest. → **S:** ==Being tired==, he took rest.

rules.name: Complex → Simple : so … that
rules.bn: **so … that … cannot** গঠনকে **too … to** করা হয়; ইতিবাচক হলে **enough to**।
rules.formula: so + adj + that + cannot → too + adj + to
rules.ex: **C:** He is so strong that he can lift it. → **S:** He is ==strong enough to lift== it.

rules.name: Simple → Compound
rules.bn: Simple-এর phrase-কে পূর্ণ clause বানিয়ে **and, but, so, or** দিয়ে যুক্ত করতে হয়।
rules.formula: phrase → clause + and / but / so + clause
rules.ex: **S:** Being poor, he could not buy it. → **Cd:** He ==was poor and could not buy== it.

rules.name: Complex → Compound
rules.bn: Subordinate clause-কে principal clause বানিয়ে **and/but/so** দিয়ে যুক্ত করো। **Though/Although → but**, **As/Since/Because → and so**, **If → or / and**।
rules.formula: Though → but · As/Since → and so · If not → or
rules.ex: **C:** Though he is poor, he is honest. → **Cd:** He is poor ==but he is honest==.

rules.name: Compound → Complex
rules.bn: একটি principal clause-কে subordinate করতে হয় — **but → though/although**, **and so → as/since**, **or → if … not**।
rules.formula: but → Though … · and so → As … · or → If … not
rules.ex: **Cd:** He is poor but he is honest. → **C:** ==Though he is poor==, he is honest.

rules.name: Positive → Comparative
rules.bn: **not so/as … as** গঠনকে **comparative + than** করতে হয় — তুলনার দিক উল্টে যায়।
rules.formula: A is not so tall as B → B is taller than A
rules.ex: **P:** Rahim is not so tall as Karim. → **C:** ==Karim is taller than Rahim==.

rules.name: Comparative → Superlative
rules.bn: **greater than any other** গঠনকে **the + superlative** করতে হয়।
rules.formula: greater than any other X → the greatest X
rules.ex: **C:** Dhaka is bigger than any other city in Bangladesh. → **S:** Dhaka is ==the biggest city== in Bangladesh.

rules.name: Superlative → Positive / Comparative
rules.bn: **the + superlative** → Comparative-এ **greater than any other**; Positive-এ **No other … as … as**।
rules.formula: the biggest → bigger than any other → No other … as big as
rules.ex: **S:** He is the best boy. → **C:** He is better than any other boy. → **P:** ==No other boy is as good as he==.

rules.name: Very few / Not many দিয়ে তুলনা
rules.bn: ‘খুব কম’ অর্থে Positive-এ **Very few … as … as**, Comparative-এ **greater than most other**, Superlative-এ **one of the greatest**।
rules.formula: one of the + superlative + plural noun
rules.ex: **S:** Dhaka is one of the biggest cities. → **P:** ==Very few cities are as big as Dhaka==.

rules.name: অর্থ যেন না বদলায়
rules.bn: রূপান্তরের একমাত্র শর্ত — **গঠন বদলাবে, অর্থ নয়**। উত্তর লিখে একবার পড়ে মিলিয়ে দেখো মূল বাক্যের অর্থ ঠিক আছে কি না।
rules.ex: ‘He is too weak to walk’ ≠ ‘He is so weak that he can walk’ — একটি শব্দেই অর্থ উল্টে যায়।

boardQ.instruction: Transform the following sentences as directed. — নির্দেশ অনুযায়ী বাক্যগুলো রূপান্তর করো। (5)
boardQ.text: (a) Being ill, he could not attend the class. (Complex) (b) He is too weak to carry the box. (Complex) (c) Though he is poor, he is honest. (Simple) (d) As he was tired, he took rest. (Simple) (e) He is poor but he is happy. (Complex) (f) Dhaka is the biggest city in Bangladesh. (Comparative) (g) Rahim is not so tall as Karim. (Comparative) (h) He is the best boy in the class. (Positive) (i) If you do not read, you will fail. (Compound) (j) He is so strong that he can lift it. (Simple)

items.ans: As he was ill, he could not attend the class.
He is so weak that he cannot carry the box.
In spite of his poverty, he is honest.
items.why: Though-clause → **In spite of + noun** phrase = Simple. (নিয়ম ০৫)

items.ans: Being tired, he took rest.
Though he is poor, he is happy.
Dhaka is bigger than any other city in Bangladesh.
Karim is taller than Rahim.
items.why: ‘not so … as’ → **comparative**, তুলনার দিক উল্টে যায়। (নিয়ম ১০)

items.ans: No other boy in the class is as good as he.
Read, or you will fail.
He is strong enough to lift it.

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — Simple / Complex / Compound চেনা
drills.intro: আগে clause গুনে ধরন বলো, তারপর রূপান্তর করো।

items.q: In spite of his poverty, he is happy. (Complex)
items.ans: Though he is poor, he is happy.
items.why: Phrase → clause; In spite of → Though. (০২)

items.q: He worked hard and he succeeded. (Simple)
items.ans: Working hard, he succeeded.

items.q: As he is honest, all like him. (Compound)
items.ans: He is honest and all like him.

items.q: He is too poor to buy a car. (Complex)
items.ans: He is so poor that he cannot buy a car.
I know what his name is.

items.q: He is rich but he is unhappy. (Simple)
items.ans: In spite of his riches, he is unhappy.
items.why: Compound → Simple: but → In spite of + noun। (০৫)

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — Degree পরিবর্তন
drills.intro: মনে রেখো — তুলনার দিক ঠিক রাখতে হবে, নইলে অর্থ উল্টে যাবে।

items.q: Iron is more useful than any other metal. (Superlative)
items.ans: Iron is the most useful metal.

items.q: No other boy is as clever as Rahim. (Superlative)
items.ans: Rahim is the cleverest boy.
items.why: No other … as … as → the + superlative। (১২)

items.q: He is the tallest boy in the class. (Comparative)
items.ans: He is taller than any other boy in the class.

items.q: Karim is not so wise as Rahim. (Comparative)
items.ans: Rahim is wiser than Karim.
items.why: not so…as → comparative; দিক উল্টে যায়। (১০)

items.q: Dhaka is one of the biggest cities. (Positive)
items.ans: Very few cities are as big as Dhaka.
items.why: one of the + superlative → Very few … as … as। (১৩)

items.q: Very few metals are as useful as iron. (Comparative)
items.ans: Iron is more useful than most other metals.
items.why: Very few … as … as → more … than most other। (১৩)

extras.note: **পড়ার কৌশল:** এই ছকের সারিগুলো আড়াআড়ি পড়ো। একই অর্থের তিন রূপ একসাথে মনে থাকলে যেকোনো দিকেই রূপান্তর করা যায়।

@Dhaka is bigger than any other city.
@Dhaka is the biggest city.
Very few boys are as good as he.
@He is better than most other boys.
@He is one of the best boys.
Rahim is not so tall as Karim.
@Karim is taller than Rahim.

extras.note: **সূত্র:** superlative → ‘than any other’ → ‘No other … as … as’। উল্টো দিকেও একই পথ ধরে ফিরে আসো।

tips.d: একটি finite verb = Simple; connector-সহ দুই clause = Complex/Compound। গোনা শিখলেই ধরন চেনা সহজ।
Though ↔ but ↔ In spite of · As/Since ↔ and so ↔ Being · If not ↔ or ↔ Without। এই তিন-জোড়াই বেশিরভাগ প্রশ্ন ঢেকে দেয়।
রূপান্তরের পরে বাক্যটি পড়ে দেখো — মূল অর্থ বদলে গেলে পুরো নম্বর যায়, গঠন যতই সুন্দর হোক।
‘Rahim is not so tall as Karim’ → **Karim** taller (Rahim নয়)। তুলনার দিক উল্টাতে ভুলো না।
শুধু বদলে যাওয়া অংশ নয়, সম্পূর্ণ বাক্যটি লিখতে হবে — বড় হাতের অক্ষর ও দাঁড়িসহ।
নির্দেশে যা চাওয়া হয়েছে ঠিক সেটিই করো। Complex চাইলে Compound লিখলে নম্বর নেই।

recap: Simple = ১ clause; Complex = principal + subordinate; Compound = দুই principal।
Simple↔Complex: participle/phrase ↔ subordinate clause (as, though, if, that)।
Complex↔Compound: Though↔but, As/Since↔and so, If not↔or।
Degree: the + superlative ↔ comparative + than any other ↔ No other … as … as।
homework: ‘Three forms of one meaning’ ছকের ৬টি সারি মুখস্থ করবে।
Degree change ছকটি খাতায় তুলে আনবে।
বোর্ডের ১০টি বাক্য না দেখে রূপান্তর করবে।
নিজে ৫টি বাক্য লিখে তিন রূপেই (Simple/Complex/Compound) লিখবে।
